literal: If a fool who does not know the proper method of action undertakes a task, will it only fail? He will also wear fetters.
translation: If a fool who does not know the proper way of doing things undertakes a task, not only will the task fail, but he will also end up wearing fetters.
modern: செயல் செய்யும் முறையை அறியாத அறிவிலி ஒரு செயலை மேற்கொண்டால், அச்செயல் கெடுவது மட்டுமன்றி, அவன் விலங்கையும் (சிறைத்தண்டனையையும்) பூண நேரிடும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the double disaster that occurs when an ignorant person (பேதை) attempts a task without knowing the proper methods (கையறியா). First, the undertaking itself is bound to fail (பொய்படும்). Second, the consequences of his foolish actions will not stop at mere failure; he will also face punishment or imprisonment, metaphorically described as wearing fetters (புனைபூணும்). The word 'ஒன்றோ' (is it only one?) highlights that failure is not the only outcome, emphasizing the compounding nature of a fool's mistakes.
